items.quote: Can I share a perspective? I open to a different perspective. This those type of question gonna create on the client side an automative response yes. Because no one gonna say no.
items.statement: No one is going to say no to positive-directed questions.

items.quote: psychologically, when I am as a client saying yes, I'm way more open to accept whatever you are.
items.statement: Saying yes makes clients more open to accepting offerings.

items.quote: but look there is this feature and this benefit and Dubai is way better and Tokyo is even more expensive.
items.statement: Sales presentations should include features and benefits comparison.

overview: This source chunk presents observations about client engagement techniques in sales, particularly focusing on the use of questions to foster positive responses and openness in clients.
